description.html: This 50x45x35 cm aquarium (78.8 L) strikes a good balance between size and practicality: roomy enough for a variety of fish, yet compact enough not to dominate the room. The quality of the glass and joints guarantees durability.
The dimensions allow a varied aquascape: wood, stone, live plants and quality substrate. We recommend an external or internal filter, a heater with a thermostat and LED lighting suited to plants.

We build custom aquariums: any dimensions, glass thickness matched to the volume, optional openings for filters and heaters. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for a consultation and a price. Delivery to all cities in Serbia.
